answer: Coordination-Priced Identity Kernel. Each new identity must post a deposit that vests along a vine of prior interactions: the deposit unlocks only after the identity completes N distinct pairwise coordination rounds with already-trusted agents, each round recording mutual work. A terrace of graduated reputation tiers gates access to higher-value tasks, so fresh identities stay capped until the vine matures. An attacker running k sybils pays k deposits plus the full interaction cost of N rounds per identity, making mass fakery scale linearly in real work rather than in registrations.
